label: Bible Study
prompt: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a _____ unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
verse: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
note: Ezekiel's job title — a watchman on the wall, warning the city of what's coming.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the disciples were filled with _____, and with the Holy Ghost.
verse: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
note: Even after being run out of Antioch, the disciples were filled with joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a _____.
verse: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
note: David's victory song: by God's help he could run through a troop and leap over a wall.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; _____ stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
verse: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
note: Jude's word pictures for false teachers: wild waves foaming shame, and stars drifting off course into darkness.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But when the _____ of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
verse: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
note: 'The fulness of the time' — God's clock struck, and his Son arrived. The KJV spells fulness with one l.
